description: The four mandated security tests and the documentation updates that complete the feature. Depends on FEAT-002 (enforcement) and FEAT-003 (CLI/UI surfaces). The security tests are the explicit anti-spoofing and scope proofs the task requires; the docs cover CLI.md, MANUAL.md, and DESIGN.md. Grounded in design.md sections 8, 9, 10, 11.
steps: internal/grpc/admin_authz_test.go (new, using the existing mTLS test harness in grpc_test.go): Test (a) admin passes the gate for every server-equivalent op — issue a client cert, register it, add its SPKI to the admin list, then assert RestoreToTarget A->B succeeds via a stub CrossRestorer, ControlClientWatcher succeeds via a stub ClientWatcherController, ListBackups with another client's id AND with an empty id is NOT forced to self (admin sees requested/all), DeleteFromBackup does NOT return PermissionDenied and instead hits the 'deletion engine not configured' precondition (marked pending per §3.2.4), and GetRetention is global/unchanged.

internal/grpc/admin_authz_test.go: Test (b) non-admin is denied/scoped — from a client whose SPKI is NOT in the list: RestoreToTarget and ControlClientWatcher return codes.PermissionDenied; DeleteFromBackup returns codes.PermissionDenied (the §3.2.4 hard gate) asserted before the nil-engine precondition; ListBackups with another client's id AND with an empty id are BOTH forced to the caller's own trusted scope (assert results contain only the caller's own jobs in both cases, proving the empty-id soft spot is closed); GetRetention global/unchanged.

internal/grpc/admin_authz_test.go: Test (c) authorization keys off the trusted TLS identity, not a name — a non-admin client sends client-id gRPC metadata equal to an admin's client NAME; assert it is still denied RestoreToTarget/ControlClientWatcher (proves name-spoofing fails and only the cert SPKI matters).

internal/config/config_test.go: ensure (or add) the backward-compat assertion that a tergum.toml without an [admin] section loads to an empty admin list (the fourth mandated test; may already exist from FEAT-001 — confirm it is present and passing).

docs/CLI.md: add a command-index entry and a `tergum admin-client` section (add/remove/list with --fingerprint/--yes/--json/--dry-run, examples) and the `tergum client fingerprint` helper; document the caveat that the CLI --config must match the running server's config path for an edit to take effect at the authorizer.

docs/MANUAL.md: document the admin-client concept, the name<->fingerprint model with mandatory operator confirmation, the revocation bound (Web UI removals immediate via synchronous Reload; CLI removals within <=5s via the ticker), and the cert-reissue caveat (re-issuing a client cert regenerates the key, changing its SPKI, so a re-issued client loses admin status until re-added).

docs/DESIGN.md: add the authorization model to the security section — the SPKI fingerprint trusted identity, enforcement inside the internal/grpc command handlers after mTLS verification, and the server-equivalent scope (cross-client restore, all-client list, watcher control; delete gated-but-pending; retention global).
acceptance_criteria: `go test ./internal/grpc/...` passes with the three security integration tests (admin-allowed, non-admin-denied/scoped, name-spoof-denied) all green.
`go test ./internal/config/...` passes with the no-[admin] backward-compat test green.
docs/CLI.md, docs/MANUAL.md, and docs/DESIGN.md describe the admin-client command surface, the SPKI/name model, the revocation bound, and the cert-reissue caveat.
The full suite is green end-to-end: `make build` && `make lint` && `make test`.
findings:
Implemented and committed on feature/admin-clients. The four mandated security proofs and the three doc updates that complete the admin-client feature.

SECURITY TESTS (internal/grpc/admin_authz_test.go, NEW):
- Harness approach: the mandated proofs exercise the CommandServer handlers DIRECTLY over a context carrying a verified mTLS peer cert, built via peer.NewContext + credentials.TLSInfo (the exact pattern already used by admin_policy_test.go's spkiCtxFingerprint/makeSharedCNCert). This is the project's existing in-process mTLS identity harness — it drives clientSPKIFromContext, the real authorization path, without a network listener (grpc_test.go likewise calls handlers directly rather than dialing). New local helpers that do NOT collide with existing package test symbols: makeNamedCert(t, cn) -> (*x509.Certificate, spkiFP) generates a fresh Ed25519 leaf with a chosen CN and returns its SPKI fingerprint; peerCtx(cert) and peerCtxWithClientID(cert, clientID) build the peer/metadata contexts; newAuthzRegistry(t) stands up an isolated shared-cache in-memory sqlite registry (unique DSN token per test so shared caches don't bleed); scopeRepo embeds grpc_test.go's mockRepo and overrides ListJobs to honor filter.ClientID so force-scoping is observable; stubCrossRestorer and stubWatcherController are the injected CrossRestorer/ClientWatcherController stubs. REUSED from admin_policy_test.go: writeAdminConfig, NewConfigAdminPolicy. REUSED from grpc_test.go: mockRepo, mockBackupEngine.
- (a) TestAdminAuthz_AdminAllowedForAllServerEquivalentOps: registers admin-ops/client-a/client-b with SPKI fingerprints, puts admin-ops' SPKI in [admin], builds a live configAdminPolicy. Asserts: RestoreToTarget A->B succeeds and the stub CrossRestorer was invoked (FilesSent=3, Success); ControlClientWatcher(start) succeeds and StartClientWatcher(client-a) was called; ListBackups(client-b) returns ONLY client-b's job (admin not forced to self); ListBackups(empty) returns ALL jobs (admin sees all); DeleteFromBackup is NOT PermissionDenied and instead returns codes.InvalidArgument (the nil deletion-engine precondition — the §3.2.4 pending stand-in); GetRetention is not admin-gated (never PermissionDenied).
- (b) TestAdminAuthz_NonAdminDeniedAndScoped: caller SPKI is NOT in [admin] (a different admin exists in config). Asserts RestoreToTarget and ControlClientWatcher => codes.PermissionDenied; DeleteFromBackup => codes.PermissionDenied (the hard gate, asserted as the returned code — it precedes the nil-engine precondition per §3.2.4); ListBackups(client-b) AND ListBackups(empty) are BOTH force-scoped to the caller's own trusted identity (results contain ONLY client-a jobs, exactly 1 each — proving the empty-id soft spot is closed); GetRetention never PermissionDenied.
- (c) TestAdminAuthz_NameSpoofViaClientIDMetadataStillDenied: a non-admin attacker (own distinct key, registered as client-a) sends client-id gRPC metadata equal to the admin's client NAME "admin-ops" while presenting its OWN cert. Asserts callerIsAdmin(spoofCtx)==false and RestoreToTarget/ControlClientWatcher => PermissionDenied, while the real admin cert IS authorized (sanity) — proving authorization keys off the cert SPKI, never the name or client-id metadata.

BACKWARD-COMPAT CONFIG TEST (4th mandated): confirmed PRESENT and PASSING — internal/config/config_test.go::TestLoadConfigWithoutAdminSection (added in FEAT-001) loads a tergum.toml with no [admin] section and asserts len(cfg.Admin.Clients)==0 and cfg.Validate()==nil. No change needed.

DOCS:
- docs/CLI.md: added Command Index rows for `tergum client fingerprint` and the `tergum admin-client` group (add/remove/list). New '#### tergum client fingerprint' subsection (SPKI identity, --json, any node role, reissue note). New '### tergum admin-client' section documenting the SPKI/name model, the server/hybrid-only guard, the config-path caveat (CLI --config must match the server's config for the edit to reach the authorizer), the revocation bound (Web UI immediate, CLI <=5s), plus add (--fingerprint/--yes, trusted vs registry-lookup paths, honors global --json/--dry-run), remove (--fingerprint), and list (full 64-hex, status). Added an 'Admin-client cross-client restore (from a client node)' note to the `tergum restore` --target requirements.
- docs/MANUAL.md: added '### Admin Clients (cross-client restore)' under Remote Backup covering the concept, the name<->fingerprint model with mandatory operator confirmation (interactive y/N or --yes; Web UI confirm click), the revocation bound (Web UI immediate via synchronous Reload, CLI <=5s via the ticker, config-path match requirement), and the cert-reissue caveat (reissue regenerates the key -> new SPKI -> admin status dropped until re-added).
- docs/DESIGN.md: added '### Admin-Client Authorization Model' to the Security Model section (§18) — SPKI fingerprint trusted identity (not CN, not client-id), fail-closed AdminPolicy with 5s ticker + synchronous Reload, enforcement inside internal/grpc CommandServer handlers AFTER mTLS, and the server-equivalent scope (cross-client restore, all-client list, watcher control; delete hard-gated-then-pending; retention global/ungated), plus the cert-reissue property. Added two threat-mitigation table rows (privilege escalation; admin impersonation by name/metadata).
